bounded_conclusion: No primary candidate meets the unchanged 80% correctly accepted supported coverage and 5% OOD threshold on selection or public development. Token-order capacity is demonstrated by a synthetic controlled training test, but this sequence family does not establish reliable language transfer or a consistent relative-position ablation benefit. Raw errors remain, so threshold changes alone cannot establish the goal. Independent v4 held language remains unread until root formal freeze.

campaign_totals.scope: Actual five development campaigns; all repeated training/caches retained and charged. Not minimal serving state or process RSS.

interface_refactor_note: After the fifth development run, deployment helpers/class were moved unchanged from routing_study.py to routing_bundle.py. Old executed source snapshots remain exact; all seven mechanism tests passed after the move. Root will run the integrated development path on final frozen source.
